In front of me, a Boston Police SUV (license plate 7202, vehicle #4511) was sitting stationary without a turn signal or hazard lights on approximately 10 past the corner of the turn down Garden Street. I called out my window asking what she was doing/where she was trying to go. This was not clear and she made no indication to me. I then said all cars should have reverse lights so people behind are aware and don't get into an accident. The officer proceeded to sarcastically question me by asking if she "was stalled", said it's not her problem and to contact to the city of Boston. After leaving the scene, I legally parallel parked my vehicle, walked back uphill, and took down her plate and vehicle #s. She accused me of taking a photo, which I did not, and when asked what I was doing (contacng the city as I was told), she gave me a sarcasc "OKAY, you do that". This officer's handling of the situation was very passive aggressive, immature, and irresponsible on a narrow one‐way street. She did not make any signal or have reverse lights as she backed up the hill with me behind her.
